unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0001
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > Abstract
text: In the process of electroless cobalt plating, the saccharin additive can significantly change the surface morphology, texture orientation, and conductivity of the cobalt coating layer. When the amount of saccharin was 3 mg·L –1, the cobalt coating transformed from disordered large grains to a honeycomb structure, with a preferred orientation of (002) facet on hexagonal close-packed (HCP) cobalt crystals. The resistivity of the cobalt film decreased to 14.4 μΩ·cm, and further decreased to 10.7 μΩ·cm after the annealing treatment.

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0002
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > Abstract
text: The resistivity of the cobalt film decreased to 14.4 μΩ·cm, and further decreased to 10.7 μΩ·cm after the annealing treatment. When the concentration of saccharin was increased, the grain size was gradually refined and a “stone forest” structure was observed, with the preferred orientation remaining unchanged. The addition of saccharin also slightly improves the purity of cobalt coating to a certain extent.

text: The addition of saccharin also slightly improves the purity of cobalt coating to a certain extent. Through the study of the crystallization behavior of cobalt electroless plating, saccharin molecules can adsorb to specific c-sites on the cobalt dense crystal plane, inhibiting the growth of abc stacking arrangement and inducing the crystal growth in ab stacking mode, thereby achieving optimal growth of HCP (002) texture. Keywords: Electroless cobalt plating; Additives; Saccharin; Crystallization behavior

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0008
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > 1. Introduction
text: At present, the cobalt interconnects in silicon chip are realized through electroplating cobalt super-filling. Although there have been reports on the research of electroplated cobalt super-filling in chip microholes [9–11], compared with electrodeposited copper, electrodeposited cobalt is prone to forming holes and cracks due to such issues as hydrogen evolution, homogenization and poor coating quality [12]. Electroless plating is one of the most practical routs to realize cobalt plating in industrial-scale since it presents a good coverage ability, facile processing and low cost.

text: Nevertheless, the researches on quantum chemical calculation of the electroless cobalt plating under the influence of additives are insufficient. Therefore, it is of great significance to establish a method based on quantum chemical calculation to study the effect of additives on cobalt plating. Upon electroless cobalt plating, we observed that the addition of saccharin would change the morphology of cobalt plating. Then we systematically studied the effects of saccharin additive on the microstructure, crystallization behavior, and conductivity of cobalt plating.

text: Then we systematically studied the effects of saccharin additive on the microstructure, crystallization behavior, and conductivity of cobalt plating. It was found that adding an appropriate amount of saccharin can effectively adsorb specific crystal planes of cobalt crystals, thereby directionally regulating their growth behavior and obtaining cobalt coatings with (002) texture preferred orientation, which promotes the conductivity of cobalt coatings.

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0017
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > 1. Introduction
text: It was found that adding an appropriate amount of saccharin can effectively adsorb specific crystal planes of cobalt crystals, thereby directionally regulating their growth behavior and obtaining cobalt coatings with (002) texture preferred orientation, which promotes the conductivity of cobalt coatings. At the same time, density functional theory (DFT) simulations provided insights into the crystallization behavior of cobalt coatings, revealing that saccharin molecules can adsorb to specific sites on the cobalt dense crystal plane, blocking abc packing and inducing crystal growth in ab stacking mode to form hexagonal close-packed structure (002) texture.

section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > 4. Conclusions
text: In the process of electroless cobalt plating, the addition of saccharin changes the microstructure of the obtained cobalt layer. The addition of a small amount of saccharin at a concentration of 3 mg·L –1 caused the cobalt plating film to change from disordered orientation to hexagonal texture, with the preferred orientation of (002) facet of HCP Co phase. Continuous increase in the saccharin concentration (>200 mg·L –1) resulted in the refinement of cobalt film grains with a “Stone Forest” morphology.

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0070
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > 4. Conclusions
text: Continuous increase in the saccharin concentration (>200 mg·L –1) resulted in the refinement of cobalt film grains with a “Stone Forest” morphology. The honeycomb morphologic cobalt coating with the appropriate addition of saccharin (3 mg·L –1) presented a tight grain boundary connection, thereby reducing the resistance to 10.7 μΩ·cm.

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0071
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > 4. Conclusions
text: The honeycomb morphologic cobalt coating with the appropriate addition of saccharin (3 mg·L –1) presented a tight grain boundary connection, thereby reducing the resistance to 10.7 μΩ·cm. After studying the cobalt crystallization process and conducting DFT simulations, it is found that the charge density near the aromatic ring of saccharin is increased from the Co surface donation, so that the saccharin molecules can adsorb to specific c-sites on the surface of densely packed cobalt atoms, hindering the abc stacking arrangement.

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0072
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > 4. Conclusions
text: After studying the cobalt crystallization process and conducting DFT simulations, it is found that the charge density near the aromatic ring of saccharin is increased from the Co surface donation, so that the saccharin molecules can adsorb to specific c-sites on the surface of densely packed cobalt atoms, hindering the abc stacking arrangement. The crystallization process can be tuned to proceed along the ab stacking, thus forming the (002) preferred texture of HCP cobalt.

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0073
section: Effect of Saccharin on Crystallization Behavior of Electroless Cobalt Plating > 4. Conclusions
text: The crystallization process can be tuned to proceed along the ab stacking, thus forming the (002) preferred texture of HCP cobalt. The findings from this study not only provide a detailed understanding of the role of saccharin in electroless cobalt plating, but also offer a theoretical framework for the design and optimization of additives in electroless plating processes.

unit_id: 糖精对镀钴层结构_导电能力的改变#0078
section: 化学镀钴过程中添加剂糖精对结晶取向的调控 > 摘要：
text: 在化学镀钴过程中， 我们发现添加剂糖精的加入可明显改变化学镀钴层表面的形貌、 织构取向及镀层的导电性。 研究表明， 当糖精添加量为 3 mg ·L^-1 时， 钴镀层由无序大晶粒转变为蜂巢状结构， 具有密排六方 （HCP） 钴晶体的 （002） 择优取向， 其电阻率降低至 1 4.4 μ Ω · cm ， 经过热处理后， 电阻率进一步降低至 1 0.7 ~ μ Ω · cm ， 这对于其在芯片中的应用具有重要价值。 当糖精浓度升高时， 晶粒逐渐细化， 呈现 “石林” 状结构， 择优取向不变， 而糖精的加入在一定程度上提高了镀钴膜的纯度。 通过密度泛函理论对钴镀层结晶行为的研究表明， 糖精分子可吸附于钴密排晶面的特定 c 位点， 抑制 abc 堆积方式生长， 诱导晶体按 ab 堆积方式生长， 从而实现 HCP（002） 晶面的择优生长。 关键词：化学镀钴； 添加剂； 糖精； 结晶行为
